title: Graduate/ Junior Estimator
rationale: Graduate or junior estimator role at a direct Cairns commercial builder; the advert says no estimating experience is needed and names Civil Engineering among accepted qualifications, which Marc's BSCE and Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design meet.

Duties (reviewing drawings and specifications, quantity take-offs, supplier and subcontractor enquiries, comparing quotes) trace to his coursework cost estimates and bills of quantities, his drawing review on site and his procurement and materials tracking in the Philippines.
Office-based in Cairns; applicants must live there or be willing to relocate, and Marc's record says only that he is open to discussing relocation.
caution: Commercial building estimating rather than civil works. Relocation to Cairns needs Marc's confirmation before applying. Estimating experience is coursework only; no Bluebeam, E1 or Benchmark use.
gaps: No paid estimating experience; estimating is coursework only
No Australian construction work experience; site work was in the Philippines 2019 to 2020
Not based in Cairns; relocation not yet confirmed by Marc
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (no link out). SEEK questions: right to work, years of estimating experience, notice period.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an Estimator?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
